topic: Early automation, Memory Web guidance, and Scourge balance
currentUserGoal: Make early automation arrive sooner and matter more, make useful automation upgrades easier to find, and restore enough Scourge pressure that the field cannot coast unattended.
workCompleted: Lowered early Tiny Sprinkler, Field Mouse, and Bee Hive Run Touch costs and softened their repeat-purchase cost growth.
Raised early helper recipe speed and output, increased throughput-rank value, and gave the first Field Mouse enough starting Seeds to demonstrate its loop.
Strengthened Damp Furrows so the Tiny Sprinkler and Field Mouse form a meaningful early production link.
Added first-run manual Care feedback while preserving the inevitable first collapse at approximately nineteen seconds.
Removed the redundant TOUCH READY and TOUCH RECOVERING field labels while retaining the visible cooldown bar.
Added semantic Memory Web colors for helper unlocks, speed, efficiency, storage, starting stock, and modes.
Added a clickable AUTOMATION PICK recommendation that focuses the next useful automation Memory.
Retuned post-first-run Scourge upward after the automation pass: Run 2 opens at 4.94 Care per second and reaches approximately 1.79 times that demand after thirty seconds.

Locked the intended pressure band with deterministic simulations: ideal Run 2 play lasts about 106 seconds, while two Sprinklers and one Mouse leave about 36.7 HP after a sixty-second hands-off window.
verificationRun: Focused EcosystemSystem and EcosystemMemoryTree verification passed: 66 tests.
npm run check passed: ESLint, 204 Vitest tests across 24 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
The served ecosystem playtest entered Run 2 with the expected 4.94 Care per second Scourge demand.
The live route reported no browser errors.
git diff --check passed apart from normal Windows LF-to-CRLF notices.
knownIssues: The deterministic targets are intentionally firmer, but the final feel still needs hands-on play across several consecutive runs.
The automation recommendation currently prioritizes unlocked helper speed, then the next helper unlock, then additional speed and efficiency ranks.
The unrelated docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains untracked and is not part of this release.
nextRecommendedSteps: Play Runs 2 through 5 without debug bonuses and judge whether automation creates breathing room without removing the need to intervene.
Tune individual helper recipes rather than globally weakening Scourge if one production chapter remains underpowered.
Expand the recommendation system if players still struggle to identify health, field-growth, or helper-mode progression.
doNotRevert: Do not restore the TOUCH READY or TOUCH RECOVERING labels; the cooldown bar is the approved field feedback.
Do not undo the semantic Memory category colors or clickable automation recommendation.
Do not weaken the newly accelerated helpers when adjusting Scourge; these systems are now covered by separate balance guards.
Do not include docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
